purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: San Luis

queries.query: San Luis Argentina official cadastral parcel map GIS catastro municipal provincial
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the provincial Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales, its official catastro website, the Instituto Geográfico Nacional provincial-office page naming the custodian, and the official provincial Atlas Geográfico Digital map application. The accessible atlas is a general geographic atlas and exposes locality/block layers, not a parcel service.

queries.query: San Luis Argentina catastro mapa parcelas oficial GIS
queries.result: Spanish-language first-party discovery identified the provincial cadastral authority and San Luis Atlas map catalog. The provincial cadastral law confirms the authority administers territorial/legal-object data and registers surveys, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales, Provincia de San Luis
registryEvidence.locality: San Luis city / San Luis Province
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The IGN provincial page identifies the Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales and gives its San Luis Capital office. Provincial Law V-0597-2007 assigns the authority administration of territorial objects, cadastral cartography, and survey registration. This evidences a provincial cadastral custodian, not open citywide parcel geometry access.

officialSources.observation: Official IGN page names Lic. Marcelo López of the Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales, gives the San Luis Capital office, and links the provincial catastro site.
Published provincial cadastral law states that the Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales administers territorial-object data and registers cadastral surveys.
Official provincial map catalog links the Atlas Geográfico Digital de la Provincia de San Luis web application.

parcelDiscovery.source: San Luis provincial catastro website and official Atlas Geográfico Digital
parcelDiscovery.note: The accessible official atlas configuration was inspected and exposed general layers including Localidades and Manzanas, but no parcel layer or parcel geometry response. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted and was not used as an absence test.

uncertainty: The provincial catastro website returned HTTP 403, so its current viewer/API configuration could not be inspected.
The official atlas is a general geographic application; its exposed layers did not include cadastral parcels, and no parcel query was inferred from the block layer.
No exact-point hit was obtained; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
Citywide completeness, municipal-versus-provincial boundary correspondence, source freshness, and native parcel identity semantics remain unverified.
